testCase.name: [local] S14 Generate on the phone, then the phone leaves at once: the note still reaches the computer

descriptionHtml:
Candidate N17 · proposed P1 · a new finding waiting for Quinn's confirmation, not counted yet

Generation is not on the server: the note is still written and saved by the page, so a reload, a closed tab or a killed phone page loses a note the model already wrote; no 'generating' state on return, a failure while away is never shown, and the previous note stays on Post-Round as if it were today's

Tickets: TFA-92592 AC 15 · counts as a QA bug: to confirm · found on: dev + local (43c38a4f)

Note: 'use jobs for generation' (68f81eca) moved only billing to the server. Confirmed on dev (TC-14/S07 reload: Haiku answered, no note saved).

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-14/S07, TC-14/S26, OAT-03/S15, TC-21/S28, TC-17/S27

Approach · TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · S14 Generate on the phone, then the phone leaves at once: the note still reaches the computer

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U8 Generate runs server-side: the physician taps Generate on the phone and can move on (another patient, background, close); the note appears when ready, on the computer too, whether or not the phone's … (UAT 3.5; TFA-92592 AC 15) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U4 A note generated on the phone appears on the computer in real time, with no refresh. (UAT TC-25 step 4; UAT TC-25; TFA-94704 AC 5; TFA-94513 AC 11) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • U6 Steps 2-5 (add, pre-round save, generate, delete) work the same in Nursing Home as in Hospital. (UAT TC-25 step 6; UAT TC-25; UAT 3.3) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Computer on {hospitalPatient}'s Post-Round tab; phone on the Encounter tab with typed encounter text

When The phone taps Generate Note & Finish and, 1 s later, its browser context is closed (stands in for lock, background or leaving the chart). Run in both modes

Then Within 120 s the computer shows the note, with no reload. A failure message there is acceptable only when the AI call itself failed

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Scripted: Pass only if, within 120 s and with no reload, the computer page shows the note (Hospital 'crackles', Nursing Home 'CBC'). A generation-failure message on the computer (the UAT's 'Note not generated' state) is acceptable only if the aiCallLog row for that Generate (read-only) shows an error; …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S14 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-25.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; the Allure status was changed by the triage from failed to broken.

Issue type: Test issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92592 ready for qa; TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog

Not judged yet: whether a note started on the phone still reaches the computer after the phone leaves was not run, because Generate is not allowed on the local stack without Quinn's OK.

Evidence: allure-results/fb404f2c…: the spec is built and skips itself, because Generate is forbidden on the local target (capabilities.json, Quinn 2026-10-13). Run it with QA_ALLOW_LOCAL_GENERATE=1 after Quinn's OK. Main is expected to fail anyway: TC-25 knownGap TFA-92592 AC 15 (server-side Generate is in PR #101).

Duplicates (the same issue, read here): TC-25/S20

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16/17 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on dev; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-25/S14

Generate on the phone, then the phone leaves at once: the note still reaches the computer

Tickets: TFA-92592 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation (ready for qa); TFA-94513 Signing In & Session Security (in progress); TFA-94704 Production Web App Hosting + PWA (development backlog)

New local lane newspec-c: status failed in newspec-c/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

Detail:

PW, local stack, both modes: two signed-in contexts of one fresh physician — the computer (Desktop Chrome) on the chart's Post-Round tab, the phone (Pixel 7 profile) on the Encounter tab. The phone typed the encounter (kept on the server), tapped Generate Note & Finish (its generateNote mocked at its own socket, answered 8 s after it is asked) and its browser context was closed 1.2 s after the tap (stands in for lock, background or leaving). The computer waited 120 s with no reload: in both modes it still showed 'No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.' (Hospital also the spinning 'Finalizing Encounter Data…' button) and no note was ever stored; no failure message either. Judged U8 (UAT 3.5 / TFA-92592 AC 15): FAILED in both modes; the dictation is kept (passed). U4 / U6 (TFA-94513 in progress, TFA-94704 backlog) are todo, not judged. On 43c38a4f the note is still generated by the page: the browser calls ai/notes:generateNote, gets the text back and saves it with its own mutation (useNoteGeneration.ts finalize, snf EncounterTab.tsx handleGenerate); 'feat: use jobs for generation' (68f81eca) moved only the billing suggestion to a server job (no scheduler use for notes anywhere in convex/). The same loss is confirmed on dev with the real model (TC-14/S07 dev). Every Generate used a 'procedure-other' custom note template because on 43c38a4f saving a generated note queues a server billing job (billing/persistence.ts enqueueBilling → ai/billing.ts run) that no socket mock can answer and that would reach Bedrock on this stack; the template only changes the (mocked) model's instruction text. Tripwire: no model call at all during the run.

Product issue: A physician who taps Generate on the phone and pockets it (or the app is closed) gets no note anywhere: the computer keeps showing 'No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.' and nothing says the note was lost.

Evidence: 6 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — sync-probe (scripted, not written yet): two contexts with their own createAuthSession sessions (local admin key), the phone's context closed 1 s after Generate, and the aiCallLog row read with adminQuery; on dev the runner never signs in and has no admin key, so as designed it runs on the local s…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).

This case has results elsewhere too (a case shows one result: a verdict beats blocked, a run beats a skip; within a tier the worse one, on a tie the earlier one (dev, dev lanes, local lane A/C, new local lanes), test out of date ranks above passed; when all are skips the dev one, unless dev only says "local only / can't run on dev" or gives the lane's own reason):

  • [local probes] blocked (probes/results.json) — probes: blocked → blocked (blocked) Built (phone taps Generate, its context closes 1 s later; computer must show the note within 120 s; aiCallLog decides). Generate / Regenerate is forbidden on the local target (scripts/capabilities.json, Quinn 2026-10-13; dev only). The spec is built and skips itself; run it with QA_ALLOW_LOCAL_GENERATE=1 once Quinn OKs local Generate.
